title: MoM – G3 Gate Review – Project Aurora – 2026-02-20
content:
Meeting: G3 Gate Review – Project Aurora
Date: 20 February 2026
Chair: Jane Smith
Attendees: Jane Smith (PM/OCM), Marco Rossi (R&D), Sarah Chen (Procurement), Tom Walsh (Quality & Compliance), David Osei (Categories)

DECISIONS
- G3 gate conditionally passed. Full sign-off pending formula stability data and supplier lead time confirmation
- Fill weight revised from 240ml to 250ml to meet cost-per-unit target confirmed by Categories
- Fragrance variant scope deferred to G4 pending commercial assessment by Categories
- Packaging dieline to be updated to reflect revised fill weight before G4

ACTIONS
- Marco Rossi (R&D): Finalise formula stability report and submit to Quality for review by 05 March 2026
- Sarah Chen (Procurement): Confirm supplier lead times for primary packaging components and share with team by 03 March 2026
- Tom Walsh (Quality): Submit G3 quality compliance sign-off to ePPM by 07 March 2026 — dependent on Marco's report
- Lisa Park (Packaging): Update packaging dieline for revised 250ml fill weight by 10 March 2026 — dependent on Sarah's lead time confirmation

RISKS RAISED
- Supplier lead times for primary packaging may push past G4 milestone if not confirmed by 03 March
- Formula stability gap risks blocking quality sign-off at G4 if data is not complete

NEXT STEPS
- Jane to schedule G4 readiness prep meeting for week of 09 March
- All actions to be tracked in Task Planner and ePPM
